Contract EvaluateLoanRequestModule::addLoanTerm(termid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o: LoanTerm|o.ItemID = termid)
	precondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->isUnique(o: LoanTerm|o.ItemID) and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(term)
	postcondition:
		CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanTerms->includes(term) and
		result = true
}
